Chief Ministers Flag Off 'Tiranga Yatra' Across Multiple States

Multiple Chief Ministers led 'Tiranga Yatras' (flag marches) across several Indian states as part of the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign. In Uttar Pradesh, CM Yogi Adityanath participated in a march in Lucknow. In Madhya Pradesh, CM Mohan Yadav flagged off a Tiranga Yatra in Bhopal on the anniversary of the 'Quit India' movement, emphasizing national service. The yatras involved participation from youth and party members, with some events proceeding despite rain.
